question: The Great Indian desert/Thar desert is located on the western margin of which of the following mountain ranges?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aravalli Range.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Thar Desert expanded in the northwestern part of the India covers 200,000 square kilometers (77,000 square miles). 
 
• It lies within the Indian states of **Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, and Gujarat **and in the SE-region of Pakistan, the **provinces of Sindh and Punjab**.
 
• Temperature ranges from 0°C (32°F) during night to above 50°C (122°F) during daytime.
 
• Aravalli Ranges: is one of the oldest mountain ranges in the world, extended in Rajasthan, Haryana, and Gujarat.
 
• **Guru Shikhar **on Mount Abu in Rajasthan, standing at about 1,722 meters is the highest peak.
